The present petition under Article 227 of Constitution of India read with Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure seeks quashing of FIR No. 487/22 under Sections 498A/406/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, P.S. Badarpur, Delhi and the related/connected chargesheet pending before, (Mahila Court)-01/SED, Saket Court, New Delhi.
